text: Six crystalline landscapes follow different spatial rules. Folded Caverns shorten journeys through fold points; Dislocated Geodes bend direction; Phase Crystal Groves shift between solid and passable states.

The Void Starsea floods a crystal seabed. The Inverted Abyss gives ceiling and floor opposite gravity, while Topological Labyrinth doors need not lead next door. Prepare for each region's hazards, routes and way home.
